title: 전문심리위원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:4:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2-4 (Commissioning Appraisal Management Commissioners, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the National Court Administration may commission appraisal management commissioners to perform duties relating to the management of appraisal procedures among the duties of expert commissioners under the Civil Procedure Act.
(2) An appraisal management commissioner and a full-time expert commissioner may concurrently serve in both positions.
(3) Article 2-2 (2) through (5) shall apply mutatis mutandis to the period of commission of appraisal management commissioners, concurrent engagement in other occupations, provision of physical facilities necessary for performing duties, evaluations of duties, etc.
